## {.center}

<div class="title-row">
<span class="title-main">wt — Idea → Spec → Implementation Workflow</span>
<span class="title-sub">Capture anywhere, hand off to the owning repo, close the loop</span>

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 13
flowchart LR
    classDef stage fill:#2a78d6,stroke:#0b0b0b,stroke-width:1px,color:#ffffff,rx:8,ry:8
    classDef handoff fill:#1baf7a,stroke:#0b0b0b,stroke-width:1px,color:#ffffff,rx:8,ry:8
    classDef gate fill:#eda100,stroke:#0b0b0b,stroke-width:1px,color:#0b0b0b,rx:8,ry:8
    classDef terminal fill:#e6e6e2,stroke:#52514e,stroke-width:1px,color:#0b0b0b,stroke-dasharray:4 3,rx:8,ry:8

    Capture["⚙️/🤖 Capture<br/>wt idea · wt-capture / wt-seed"]:::stage
    Explore["🤖 Explore<br/>wt idea log/summary · wt-explore"]:::stage
    SpecGate{{"🤖 Spec accepted?<br/>wt spec new · wt-new-work"}}:::gate
    Rework["🤖 wt-rework<br/>epic incomplete"]:::gate

    Export["⚙️ Export — handoff to owning repo<br/>wt spec export · wt-export"]:::handoff
    Implement["🤖 Implement<br/>in the owning repo<br/>wt-implement-spec"]:::handoff
    PullBack{{"⚙️ pull-status · pull-clock"}}:::handoff

    Close["🤖 Close the loop<br/>wt spec fit-log"]:::stage

    Dropped["🤖 Dropped<br/>wt idea close --as drop"]:::terminal
    Researched["🤖 Researched<br/>wt idea close --as researched"]:::terminal

    Capture --> Explore
    Explore --> SpecGate
    SpecGate -- "epic incomplete" --> Rework
    Rework -.-> SpecGate
    SpecGate --> Export
    Export --> Implement
    Implement --> PullBack
    PullBack --> Close
    Close -. "fit signal" .-> Explore

    Explore -.-> Dropped
    SpecGate -.-> Researched
    Dropped -. "reopen" .-> Explore
    Researched -. "reopen" .-> Explore
```

::: {.legend}

| Stage | CLI | Skill |
|---|---|---|
| **Capture** | `wt idea "…"` | `wt-capture`, `wt-seed` |
| **Explore** | `wt idea log / summary / questions` | `wt-explore` |
| **Accept spec** | `wt spec new --from-idea` | `wt-new-work`, `wt-rework` |
| **Export (handoff)** | `wt spec export` | `wt-export` |
| **Implement** | — | `wt-implement-spec` *(runs in the owning repo)* |
| **Close the loop** | `wt spec pull-status/pull-clock/fit-log` · `wt idea close` | — |

**🤖 = needs human/AI judgment · ⚙️ = deterministic wt CLI (mechanical, no judgment).** wt's CLI never *decides* anything — every write (state, property, clock entry) is a drift-guarded, idempotent record of a decision already made. Judgment lives entirely in the Skills layer: what to explore, whether a design actually holds up, whether the code is really done, whether it actually worked.

**Triage, anywhere:** `wt hub --json` · `wt next` — read-only, non-mutating.
**Terminal exits are healthy outcomes, not failures:** *dropped* = won't-do, reasoned; *researched* = explored fully, value folded elsewhere via a pointer.
**Capture/Explore/Spec authxxing** run with the full `wt` CLI + skills. Once handed off, **implementation happens in the owning repo** with *only* the portable spec + `wt-implement-spec` — reconciliation back happens later, pulled from the wt side.

:::
